The treatment at the parlor was absolutely not good at all.
​Before booking, they will take confirmation for anything you want to get done, assuring you that the specific treatment is available there. However, when you arrive on the spot, the particular technician needed for your treatment will be missing.
​They will then rush and push you to get a different treatment, saying, "You can do this, this will be fine, that will be fine." After completing only half the treatment, they will make you run around to other branches, which wastes your time, wastes your money, and ruins your special occasion.
​The staff there seem more concerned about rushing the client out so they can sit down comfortably than they are about the client's needs. Nothing was proper. They are only focused on speed and rushing. They don't even let the product dry properly if they are doing a head treatment. Their only goal is to finish quickly to send you somewhere else, even using hot water which is not good for the treatment.
​They did not do any of the treatments properly. Even when you tell them about the issues, they say, "No, Madam, this is how your treatment is done." That was not good at all.
​Please don't go there; it was a total waste of time.

While checking the reviews, I realized that some people genuinely did not receive good treatment, but all those reviews and comments were deleted by the parlor. Only the old and positive comments (or 'good comments') remain visible.

I visited Lakmé Salon, Churchgate (near Eros Theatre) for a simple hair wash and blow dry, for which the charge was 1100. From the very beginning, the experience was downhill.

During the hair wash, I was asked whether I wanted a “normal shampoo” or a “sulphate free shampoo”, and was told the sulphate free shampoo would cost an additional ₹450. This upselling at the wash station itself was extremely off-putting especially when they were charging 1100. Since I needed the service only for a single function, I agreed to the normal shampoo, expecting at least a decent wash.

The real disaster started during the blow dry. Anyone with basic training knows that curly hair should be blow-dried downwards to avoid frizz. Instead, the stylist blow-dried my hair in the worst possible way, turning it into a frizzy mess. When I pointed this out, instead of acknowledging his mistake, he blamed my hair for the result, essentially covering up his lack of skill.

For context, I get blow-dries twice a month, and this has never happened to me before. Moreover i get blowdries from not very big salons in thane and they do such a better job.

I complained to the manager, who again asked the person to “fix” my hair, but he only made it even more frizzy. As compensation, they offered a ₹200 discount, which honestly felt insulting considering I walked out looking embarrassing and completely dissatisfied. Net result: ₹900 wasted and a ruined look for my function.

To make matters worse, the general vibe of the salon was terrible as the staff looked uninterested, disengaged, and in a hurry to go home. There was zero concern for customer satisfaction; it felt purely transactional and money-driven.

To top it all off, the stylist missed an entire strand of hair while blow-drying, which is clearly visible in the photo I am attaching.

Please do NOT visit this salon if you have an important event or function. They do not value their customers, do not take responsibility for poor service, and definitely do not live up to the Lakmé brand name.

featured_reviews.name: Kiran Bhardwaj
featured_reviews.review_text:
Inconsistent service and disappointing experience

I returned to this salon based on a very positive first visit, where the service felt professional and relaxing. Unfortunately, my second visit was a completely different experience.

The quality of service noticeably dropped when I did not engage much with additional product or service suggestions. The massage was far less attentive compared to my earlier visit, and the overall attitude felt conditional rather than professional.

What was most disappointing was the lack of clarity and consistency in how services were explained. Expectations were not set clearly upfront, and the experience felt misleading by the end.

After reading several other reviews here, it’s concerning to see that upselling pressure, inconsistency in service quality, and lack of transparency appear to be recurring issues at this location.

A brand like Lakmé should ensure the same level of professionalism and care for every customer, regardless of whether they opt for add-ons. Sadly, this visit left me uncomfortable, and I won’t be returning.
